sections.section_name: Section A - Objective Types / MCQs / True-False

questions.question_text: Which part of the foot is primarily used to execute a standard push pass for accurate short-distance distribution in football?
options: C) The inside of the foot
D) The outside of the foot
questions.answer: C) The inside of the foot

questions.question_text: In a competitive Kabaddi match, how many players from a single team are permitted on the court at the start of play?
Which of the following yoga postures is a standing balancing asana specifically known to improve concentration and neuro-muscular coordination?
questions.answer: A) Vrikshasana

questions.question_text: What action restarts play when the football completely crosses the sideline (touchline) of the pitch?
questions.answer: D) Throw-in

questions.question_text: A Kabaddi raider is immediately declared 'out' if they take a breath or break the continuous chant while in the opponent's half. (True/False)
questions.answer: A) True

questions.question_text: Surya Namaskar (Sun Salutation) is a traditional dynamic sequence composed of how many distinct yoga postures?
Which specific player on the football field is legally allowed to handle the ball with their hands within their designated penalty area?
questions.answer: D) Goalkeeper

questions.question_text: In Kabaddi, the raider must cross the 'Baulk line' to make the raid legitimate if no defending player is touched during the raid. (True/False)
questions.answer: A) True

questions.question_text: Which traditional Pranayama technique involves short, forceful abdominal exhalations followed by passive inhalations to clear the respiratory tract?
questions.answer: A) Kapalabhati

questions.question_text: An 'offside trap' is a coordinated defensive tactical maneuver utilized primarily in which invasion sport?
questions.answer: C) Football

questions.question_text: Define the defensive tactical concept of a 'Super Tackle' in a standard Kabaddi match. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A Super Tackle occurs when a defending team with three or fewer players successfully catches and pins the raider, awarding them two points instead of one.

questions.question_text: Explain the specific scenario that results in a 'corner kick' being awarded in football. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A corner kick is awarded to the attacking team when the ball completely crosses the goal line after being last touched by a defending player.

questions.question_text: What is the primary anatomical benefit of practicing Bhujangasana (Cobra Pose) for adolescent athletes? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Bhujangasana stretches the chest and strengthens the spinal muscles. It helps correct poor posture caused by prolonged sitting and increases overall upper-body flexibility.

questions.question_text: Describe the correct structural execution technique for a legal 'throw-in' in football. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The player must face the field, keep both feet securely on the ground, and throw the ball with both hands from behind and directly over their head.

questions.question_text: What is the primary defensive role of a 'corner' player in a Kabaddi formation? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Corner defenders anchor the extreme edges of the defensive chain. They are responsible for initiating ankle holds and preventing the raider from securing easy bonus points.

questions.question_text: Describe the strict court conditions required for an offensive raider to successfully claim a 'Bonus Point' in Kabaddi. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: The defending team must have at least six players actively on the court. The raider must cross the designated bonus line with one foot while ensuring their trailing foot is completely airborne.

questions.question_text: How does the regular practice of 'Pranayama' positively affect a student's aerobic performance during an intense football match? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Pranayama significantly expands lung capacity and improves conscious breath control. This enhances oxygen circulation during high-intensity running, delaying the onset of muscle fatigue and helping the player maintain focus and stamina.

questions.question_text: Explain the concept of 'dribbling' as an essential offensive ball-control strategy in football. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Dribbling involves keeping close possession of the ball using soft touches while running. It allows a player to maneuver past defenders, create spatial advantages, and transition into accurate passes or goal-scoring shots.

questions.question_text: Outline the correct sequential steps for executing Padmasana (Lotus Pose) to ensure stable meditation and flexibility. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Sit on the floor with legs extended. Bend the right knee and place the right foot onto the left thigh. Repeat by placing the left foot onto the right thigh, keeping the spine completely erect and hands resting on knees.

questions.question_text: Analyze how effective team communication and varied passing configurations can successfully dismantle a strong, compact defensive formation in football. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Quick, accurate short passes combined with constant verbal communication pull defenders out of their designated zones. By rapidly switching the ball across the width of the field, the attacking team creates open spaces and numerical advantages, deeply confusing the defensive line and setting up high-percentage goal-scoring opportunities.

questions.question_text: Evaluate how incorporating routine Yoga sessions can specifically enhance a Kabaddi raider's on-court agility and cant-holding capacity during a match. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Yoga postures enhance joint flexibility and core strength, allowing raiders to execute deep lunges and swift directional changes without muscular strain. Concurrently, advanced pranayama training maximizes lung volume and breath retention. This powerful combination gives the raider the stamina to maintain a continuous, loud cant while forcefully maneuvering through a tight defensive chain.
